about: Week plan for the dashboard's Week view. Coach-maintained: Sunday writes the coming Mon-Sun week; any replan updates that day's rows; keep about 2 past weeks, the current week and the next. Row kinds: week (one per Monday) and day (one per planned session; rest days get a rest row). type: run, bike, swim, strength, walk, race, test, rest. intensity: rest, easy, steady, quality, long, race, test. minutes = nominal; upper_minutes and fallback_minutes are the strong-day and fallback bounds; alt_type is the fallback discipline when it differs. key = one of the week's three key sessions (the athlete, Nov 3, 2026: the three things that must happen that week for progress or the right discipline; a rest day can be one): every week from Nov 2, 2026 has exactly three, pillar 1, 2 and 3, each with a one-line why. key and pillar always go together; nothing else is key. Base, Build and Specific weeks default to the block's three pillars (plan.json pillar_n, pillar_n_short); recover, taper, race and light weeks are the coach's choice. Rules: coach/engine/KEY-SESSIONS.md; python3 coach/tools/key_check.py must print ok.
